The following are all the emails in the inbox of Emma Johnson, each formatted as 'Sender: <sender>
Subject: <subject>
Body: <body>
CC: <cc>
BCC: <bcc>
Attachments: <attachments>
Timestamp: <timestamp>'. One of these emails is from a person named Taylor and is about a new GitHub repository he created. Identify that email and extract the following from it: 1) sender_name: Taylor's name; 2) sender_email: the email address of the sender of that email; 3) email_subject: the subject line of that email; 4) repository_name: the name of the new repository, formatted exactly as it should be passed to the GitHub tools: use the full 'owner/repository' form (for example 'taylor/my-repo') whenever the owner can be determined from the email, for instance from a github.com URL or an 'owner/repository' mention; if only the bare repository name is given, provide just the bare name; 5) action: what Taylor is asking Emma to do with the repository. It must be exactly one of the following strings: 'star' if he asks her to star it, 'unstar' if he asks her to remove a star, 'clone' if he asks her to clone it, 'create_issue' if he asks her to open an issue, 'invite_collaborator' if he asks her to add a specific person as a collaborator, 'transfer_ownership' if he asks her to transfer the repository to a new owner, or 'other' for anything else; 6) issue_title: the title of the issue to open, if Taylor asks to open an issue and specifies a title, otherwise the empty string; 7) issue_body: the description of the issue, if Taylor asks to open an issue and describes it, otherwise the empty string; 8) collaborator_email: the email address of the person to invite, if Taylor asks to invite a collaborator and provides an email address, otherwise the empty string; 9) new_owner_username: the username of the new owner, if Taylor asks to transfer ownership and mentions a username, otherwise the empty string; 10) new_owner_email: the email address of the new owner, if Taylor asks to transfer ownership and mentions an email address, otherwise the empty string; 11) clone_directory: the local directory path where the repository should be cloned, if Taylor asks to clone the repository and specifies a destination, otherwise the empty string; 12) requires_reply: true only if Taylor explicitly asks Emma to reply to him or to confirm once the action is done, otherwise false; 13) request_details: a concise but complete description of exactly what Taylor is requesting.
